HOW TO USE

STEP 1: Using Beauty Junkees pro Brow Brush, begin by brushing the brow hairs up using the spoolie.

STEP 2: Next, pick up a small amount of brow powder on your brush.

STEP 3: Define - Starting at the inner area of the brow (closest to the nose), begin to outline the bottom and the top of your brow creating clean lines.

STEP 5: Blend - Complete by brushing through the brow hairs again with the spoolie to blend product through the hairs, working in the direction of natural growth.

FAQs

Q: What color should I choose?
A: Experts suggest if you have blond hair and light brows, opt for the Taupe, but if your brows are darker, opt for Soft Brown. If you have auburn or brown hair you can opt for the Soft Brown. Q: Does the powder cover gray hairs?
A: No it does not. To cover gray hairs you would want to use a tinted brow gel.
 
Q: Is this product waterproof?
A: No, the product is a powder so it is not waterproof.
 
Q: Can I use it wet also?

HOW TO USE

STEP 1: Using Beauty Junkees pro Brow Brush, begin by brushing the brow hairs up using the spoolie.

STEP 2: Next, pick up a small amount of brow powder on your brush.

STEP 3: Define - Starting at the inner area of the brow (closest to the nose), begin to outline the bottom and the top of your brow creating clean lines.

STEP 4: Fill - With a light hand, fill in our brows by using small, soft strokes to create the look of natural hairs.

STEP 5: Blend - Complete by brushing through the brow hairs again with the spoolie to blend product through the hairs, working in the direction of natural growth.

STEP 6: Add the clear brow gel by lightly sweeping the spoolie toward the front of the brow. Sweep the brush back in the opposite direction from the front to the tail, brushing the brows back in place.

 

FAQs

Q: What color should I choose?
A: Experts suggest if you have blond hair and light brows, opt for the Taupe, but if your brows are darker, opt for Soft Brown. If you have auburn or brown hair you can opt for the Soft Brown. Q: Does the powder cover gray hairs?
A: No it does not. To cover gray hairs you would want to use a tinted brow gel.
 
Q: Is this product waterproof?
A: No, the product is a powder so it is not waterproof.
 
Q: Can I use it wet also?
A: Yes you can! Please be aware that the product will apply darker than when applied dry and will dry down to a powder.

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

Help Tips & Recommendations

Works best if you do not put other skincare products on your eyebrow before brow pen application. After application, avoid touching your eyebrows for at least 15 seconds allowing ink to dry.

You may think your pen is out of ink when it is not. If it seems to be running out, shake and let sit upside-down with the tip pointed down for at least 30 minutes.

Eyebrow dying should not be as intense as eyelash dying. Thus, we recommend to leave on the colour for 4 - 5 minutes. If the eyebrows are dyed with combinal, it is possible to create shape by dying the skin. The same is possible for the eyelashes to obtain an eyeliner effect.

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

HOW TO USE

STEP 1: Using Beauty Junkees pro Brow Brush, begin by brushing the brow hairs up using the spoolie.

STEP 2: Next, pick up a small amount of brow powder on your brush.

STEP 3: Define - Starting at the inner area of the brow (closest to the nose), begin to outline the bottom and the top of your brow creating clean lines.

STEP 4: Fill - With a light hand, fill in our brows by using small, soft strokes to create the look of natural hairs.

STEP 5: Blend - Complete by brushing through the brow hairs again with the spoolie to blend product through the hairs, working in the direction of natural growth.

STEP 6: Optionally, finish with either a clear or tinted brow gel to set the powder.

 

FAQs

Q: What color should I choose?
A: Experts suggest if you have blond hair and light brows, opt for the Taupe, but if your brows are darker, opt for Soft Brown. If you have auburn or brown hair you can opt for the Soft Brown. If you have dark brown hair that is almost black, consider the Rich Brown. At the end of the day it really comes down to personal preference.

Q: Do I need to set the brow powder with anything?
A: No you do not need to; if you don't want your brow hairs to move, then we recommend using a clear or tinted brow gel.

Q: Does the powder cover gray hairs?
A: No it does not. To cover gray hairs you would want to use a tinted brow gel.
 
Q: Is this product waterproof?
A: No, the product is a powder so it is not waterproof.
 
Q: Can I use it wet also?
A: Yes you can! Please be aware that the product will apply darker than when applied dry and will dry down to a powder.

How to Apply:
1. Using the spoolie end of Brush 12, comb brow hairs upward. Load up the brush end with DIPBROW Pomade, working off the cap using a side-to-side sweeping motion. The pomade is highly pigmented, so a little goes a long way. Use light pressure when applying.
2. For a dramatically defined brow look, start by outlining the lower arch. Blend upward using the spoolie. Next, comb hairs downward, outline the upper arch and lightly blend. Fill inside the brow in the same direction as hair’s natural growth. Continue blending throughout the application for the most natural-looking results. Finish by filling in the front of the brow using the remaining product on the brush, creating a softer gradient effect at the front end of the brow.

Cómo aplicar:

A continuación, peine los pelos hacia abajo, delinear el arco superior y mezclar ligeramente. Llenar dentro de la ceja en la misma dirección que el crecimiento natural del cabello. Continuar mezclando en toda la aplicación para obtener los resultados más naturales. Termine rellenando la parte frontal de la frente usando el producto restante en el cepillo, creando un efecto de degradado más suave en el extremo frontal de la ceja.

Como aplicar:

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

Finish by filling in the front of the brow using the remaining product on the brush, creating a softer gradient effect at the front end of the brow.

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.

Precious argan oil due to its high vitamin E content moisturises, nourishes, and smooths hair, making them look beautiful and healthy.

How To Use

For precise application, work the product from side to side on the top of the cap using Brush. Because Brush is synthetic, it works perfectly with cream formulas and is ideal for creating thin, hairlike strokes and for outlining and detailing the brow.

Start with a minimal amount of product on Brush. Using the spoolie end of the brush, comb brow hairs upward, then outline the lower arch with the brush end. Blend using the spoolie end.

Next, brush hairs downward, outline the upper arch and lightly blend. Start filling inside the brow in the same direction that the hairs grow naturally. Continue blending through the brow during application for the most natural-looking results.

Finish by filling in the front of the brow using the remaining product on the brush, creating a softer gradient effect at the front end of the brow.

Tips

Keep the cap sealed so the waterproof formula doesn’t dry out. If you need to refresh the product, add a drop of oil.

Eyebrow Pomade also works as an excellent eye shadow base for a smoky eye.

When applying, pick up just a little bit of product. The pomade formula is highly pigmented, so a little goes a long way.

description:
HOW TO USE

STEP 1: Using Beauty Junkees pro Brow Brush, begin by brushing the brow hairs up using the spoolie.

STEP 2: Next, pick up a small amount of brow powder on your brush.

STEP 3: Define - Starting at the inner area of the brow (closest to the nose), begin to outline the bottom and the top of your brow creating clean lines.

STEP 4: Fill - With a light hand, fill in our brows by using small, soft strokes to create the look of natural hairs.

STEP 5: Blend - Complete by brushing through the brow hairs again with the spoolie to blend product through the hairs, working in the direction of natural growth.

STEP 6: Optionally, finish with either a clear or tinted brow gel to set the powder.

 

FAQs

Q: What color should I choose?
A: Experts suggest if you have blond hair and light brows, opt for the Taupe, but if your brows are darker, opt for Soft Brown. If you have auburn or brown hair you can opt for the Soft Brown. If you have dark brown hair that is almost black, consider the Rich Brown. At the end of the day it really comes down to personal preference.

Q: Do I need to set the brow powder with anything?
A: No you do not need to; if you don't want your brow hairs to move, then we recommend using a clear or tinted brow gel.

Q: Does the powder cover gray hairs?
A: No it does not. To cover gray hairs you would want to use a tinted brow gel.
 
Q: Is this product waterproof?
A: No, the product is a powder so it is not waterproof.
 
Q: Can I use it wet also?
A: Yes you can! Please be aware that the product will apply darker than when applied dry and will dry down to a powder.

How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. INSTRUCTIONS:

Note: After applying once you achieve the desired shape allow the pigmentation to dry.

  • Step 1: Start with clean and dry skin. Do not apply after putting lotion on, this will make the eyebrow pen less effective.

  • Step 4: For the end of your brow, tilt the pen to fill the area with the narrower part of the pen.
  • Step 5: Correct any mistakes to get your desired shape and then let it dry for a few seconds.

Initially it will be slightly wet but that gives you the chance to fix any mistakes.

STORAGE
Use and store with the tip positioned lower than the end of the pen to ease and prolong its use as this is similar to a marker or pen. Also, always close cap tightly.

description:
Use DIPBROW Pomade’s full-pigment, waterproof formula to fill in and detail brows.
Long-wearing and smudge-resistant

Brush 12’s tapered angled shape and firm synthetic fibers make it ideal for applying DIPBROW Pomade and DIPBROW Gel to brows with precision.

The custom spoolie end blends the product for a flawless finish
Choose from 5 different shades

How to Apply:
1. Using the spoolie end of Brush 12, comb brow hairs upward. Load up the brush end with DIPBROW Pomade, working off the cap using a side-to-side sweeping motion. The pomade is highly pigmented, so a little goes a long way. Use light pressure when applying.
2. For a dramatically defined brow look, start by outlining the lower arch. Blend upward using the spoolie. Next, comb hairs downward, outline the upper arch and lightly blend. Fill inside the brow in the same direction as hair’s natural growth. Continue blending throughout the application for the most natural-looking results. Finish by filling in the front of the brow using the remaining product on the brush, creating a softer gradient effect at the front end of the brow.

Cómo aplicar:
1. Usando el extremo del spoolie de Brush 12, peine los pelos de las cejas hacia arriba. 2. Para una mirada de cejas dramáticamente definida, comience por delinear el arco inferior. Mezcla hacia arriba usando el spoolie. A continuación, peine los pelos hacia abajo, delinear el arco superior y mezclar ligeramente. Llenar dentro de la ceja en la misma dirección que el crecimiento natural del cabello. Continuar mezclando en toda la aplicación para obtener los resultados más naturales. Termine rellenando la parte frontal de la frente usando el producto restante en el cepillo, creando un efecto de degradado más suave en el extremo frontal de la ceja.

Does this work with eyebrow stencils? NO. Eyebrow stencils are best used with pencils, powders and pomades. Use a tinted or clear brow gel to set the color and shape for all day wear.

What is the best way to remove brow gel? To remove a brow gel or tint, use any makeup remover or a gentle face cleanser.

This new and revolutionary smudge-proof long lasting eyebrow pen features a micro fork tip applicator that creates hair-like strokes lasting all day to hopefully replace the old-school pencils.

Regarding Colors:

  • Brown is recommended for Brown/Auburn eyebrows (this is a Reddish Brown).

INSTRUCTIONS:

Initially it will be slightly wet but that gives you the chance to fix any mistakes.

STORAGE
Use and store with the tip positioned lower than the end of the pen to ease and prolong its use as this is similar to a marker or pen. Also, always close cap tightly.

HOW TO USE

STEP 1: Using Beauty Junkees pro Brow Brush, begin by brushing the brow hairs up using the spoolie.

STEP 2: Next, pick up a small amount of brow powder on your brush.

STEP 3: Define - Starting at the inner area of the brow (closest to the nose), begin to outline the bottom and the top of your brow creating clean lines.

STEP 4: Fill - With a light hand, fill in our brows by using small, soft strokes to create the look of natural hairs.

STEP 5: Blend - Complete by brushing through the brow hairs again with the spoolie to blend product through the hairs, working in the direction of natural growth.

FAQs

Q: What color should I choose?
A: Experts suggest if you have blond hair and light brows, opt for the Taupe, but if your brows are darker, opt for Soft Brown. If you have auburn or brown hair you can opt for the Soft Brown. Q: Do I need to set the brow powder with anything?
A: No you do not need to; if you don't want your brow hairs to move, then we recommend using a clear or tinted brow gel.

Q: Does the powder cover gray hairs?
A: No it does not. To cover gray hairs you would want to use a tinted brow gel.
 
Q: Is this product waterproof?
A: No, the product is a powder so it is not waterproof.
 
Q: Can I use it wet also?
A: Yes you can! Please be aware that the product will apply darker than when applied dry and will dry down to a powder.

Precise Lines to Frame Your Face
Eyebrows are the focal point that frame your face. Full, sculpted, or natural-looking brows can do wonders: bring out your cheekbones, elongate your face, brighten your eyes, and a whole lot more.

Shaping Your Brows
Brows define your look. Starting with the perfect shape can work wonders.
When it comes to accurately shaping your brows, this simple, three-point rule will never steer you wrong.
1. Align the start of your brow to the outside of the nose.
2. Align the arch of your brow to the outer edge of the pupil.
3. Brows should always taper off at the outer corner of the eye.

description: For anyone who wants to cover their thin, sparse, or over plucked eyebrows, Natural Brow is the ultimate solution. Within minutes, these full, natural-looking, easy-to-apply, flexible 100% human hair eyebrows provide a beautiful frame to the face. Each piece of hair is individually hand placed on a skin-like, flexible gel backing for the most natural eyebrows ever made. Each eyebrow is a work of art and may slightly vary. The eyebrow can be enhanced with makeup to modify the color or shape. The eyebrows can be cut to shape if desired. If shaping of the eyebrow is necessary, the base should be cut carefully. The eyebrow adhesive and remover are sold separately, however most false eyelash adhesive and removers will work. We suggest using adhesive remover between wearings. Is Natural Brow difficult to apply? No. Natural Brow is easily applied in seconds. Simply apply a very thin layer of adhesive onto the back of the Natural Brow, including the edges. Wait 20 seconds or more until adhesive becomes tacky, then place brow against your natural brow line. Next, gently but firmly press along the brows to secure it in place with your fingertips. How do I remove Natural Brows? Apply remover sparingly around the outer edges and gently peel the Natural Brow from your natural brow line starting at the inner corner. Apply more remover until the brow has lifted away. Be gentle, so not to remove any natural eyebrows underneath. To remove adhesive from brows after removal: Dip Q-tip sparingly in adhesive remover and lightly brush across back of eyebrow. Do not submerge! Too much remover may curl the brow so use with your discretion. Rub gently with finger or Q-tip to remove any adhesive from the back of the brow, then store them flat for future use. Another way to remove the adhesive is by using a toothpick. First loosen edge of glue then gently gather glue by "rolling" around flat side of toothpick until removed. This process is a bit more tedious, so be careful.
